title: Comprehensive Test — Chapter 6: Exponential Functions and Sequences

questions.prompt: Evaluate $5^0$.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Any nonzero number to the zero power equals 1.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: The y-values are multiplied by 2 each time, so it is exponential.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: If the graphs do not intersect, the equation has no real solution.
